_how_to_use: 1. Put YOUR OWN email addresses in identifiers.emails and the handles you use in identifiers.usernames.
2. Set enabled to true (or ask Jarvis: 'enable personal watch').
3. Ask for a check: 'is my account exposed' or run personal_watch action=check_identity.
Jarvis refuses to look up anything that is not in this file, so a request about someone else cannot work however it is phrased.
_privacy: This file stays on this machine. Identity tools make requests to public sites about the values below; nothing is sent anywhere else.
